caption:
Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return."

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:156). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-11) of GET /v1/ayah/2:156/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۭ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "Who, when disaster strikes them, say, \"Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.\""
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Verbatim: "他们遭难的时候，说：我们确是真主所有的，我们必定只归依他。"
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "재앙이 있을때 오 주여 우 리는 주안에 있으며 주께로 돌아 가나이다 라고 기도하는 자 있나니". Spacing-only fixes: '있을때' -> '있을 때'; '우 리는' -> '우리는'; '돌아 가나이다' -> '돌아가나이다'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "災難に遭うと，「本当にわたしたちは，アッラーのもの。かれの御許にわたしたちは帰ります。」と言う者，"
